newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean firms pass on 10,000T cottonseed tender.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean firms pass on 10,000T cottonseed tender.

text.p: South Korean feed mill companies on Friday passed on tenders for 10,000 tonnes of cottonseed meal due to high prices, traders said.
Traders said the lowest bid for position one of 5,000 tonnes was made by LG International Corp at $153.45 per tonne on a cost and freight basis for arrival by January 20.
The lowest bid for position two of 5,000 tonnes was made by Daewoo Corp at $151.93 a tonne, C&F, for arrival by February 20 they said.
Shipment of the passed tender must be made by a single-deck vessel to the western port of Inchon.
